sections.title: Mental model — continuous worlds & counting functions

blocks.md: **Two upgrades this level: answers become REAL numbers (precision discipline), and feasibility becomes a COUNTING function over huge virtual spaces.**

blocks.label: bulletproof real-BS pattern
blocks.py:
lo, hi = 0.0, 1e18
for _ in range(100):                     # fixed iterations beat eps loops
    mid = (lo + hi) / 2
    if feasible(mid): hi = mid
    else:             lo = mid
# answer ~ hi; 100 halvings crush any double precision need

blocks.md: **Never `while (hi−lo > eps)` on adversarial doubles** — rounding stalls. Fixed iterations always terminate; say '100 iterations ≪ time limit' and move on.

items.q: Feasible(mid)=true with minimize-goal moves which bound?
options: hi=mid — true region keeps shrinking toward optimum

blocks.md: Binary predicate dead? If f is UNIMODAL (rises then falls), compare two interior probes m1<m2: f(m1)<f(m2) ⇒ peak right of m1; else peak left of m2. Discard a THIRD each round — Θ(log₁·₅ n).

blocks.title: Trace: ternary max of f=[0,2,5,9,7,3,1] (peak at index 3)

items: Integer ternary needs careful mid placement (m1=lo+(hi-lo)/3, m2=hi-(hi-lo)/3) + plateau warnings
Alternative for integer unimodal: binary-search slope sign (a[mid]<a[mid+1]) — usually cleaner (peak template L2)
Real unimodal optimization (geometry/physics) = ternary's home turf

options: flat comparisons give no discard direction
items.explain: Unimodal STRICT required; perturb or switch tools otherwise.

items.q: 100 iterations on range 1e18 leaves interval width…
items.explain: Halving power dwarfs float ulp; termination guaranteed.

items.q: LC668 per-guess row loop caps at min(n, x/i) because…
options: row i contributes min(m, floor(x/i)) values ≤ x — cap avoids waste

items.q: Value-bisect vs heap-merge decision hinges on…
options: k's magnitude — bisect cost independent of k
items.explain: k near n² favors bisection massively.

blocks.md: Matrix sorted rows+cols, multiplication tables, pair-distances — all share one skeleton: **guess VALUE v → count elements ≤ v in O(n) or O(n+m) via structure → monotone count(v) → bisect v.** You never enumerate the giant implicit universe.

blocks.label: sorted-matrix counter (staircase count ≤ x)
blocks.py:
cnt, r, c = 0, 0, m - 1
while r < n and c >= 0:                  # start top-right
    if mat[r][c] <= x:
        cnt += c + 1                     # whole prefix of row counted
        r += 1
    else:
        c -= 1

chain.a: Sort once; count pairs ≤ d via sliding window j-pointer per i — Θ(n) per guess; total Θ(n log(maxDist)). Same doctrine as LC378 but linear-space counting.

chain.q: Why not heap-merge k smallest instead?
chain.a: Heap gives k extractions × log k each — fine for small k, dies at k~n²/4 midpoints. Value-bisect independent of k's magnitude — that's the CP-grade distinction.
Same 'jump powers of two' DNA as exponential search & sparse-table level selection; full treatment arrives with trees/LCA module.

options: NON-DECREASING — ties handled by first-true hunting

items.title: Kth Smallest Element in Sorted Matrix
items.statement: Full pipeline: counter above + value bisection; report complexity Θ((n+m)·log(range)).

items.title: Kth Smallest Number in Multiplication Table
items.statement: Table never materialized. Per-guess Σ min(x/i, m).
hints: Loop rows only up to min(n, x).

items.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Array II + Infinite Mountain (combo drill)
items.statement: Mountain array behind unknown-length interface: exponential-grow bounds until slope flips, then peak-hunt.
hints: Then reuse L2 converging peak loop.

items.title: Smallest Divisor Given Threshold
items.statement: Min divisor d so Σ ceil(a[i]/d) ≤ threshold — decreasing checker.

items.title: Real-Valued Split Min-Max (continuous books)
items.statement: Segment [0,L] line into k pieces minimizing longest piece where cut cost curve given — solve with 100-iteration real BS; explain why ints fail.

items.title: Ternary Terrain Peak
items.statement: Given strictly unimodal f as black-box array of size 10⁶, locate argmax via ternary; then re-solve with slope-bisect and compare probe counts.
hints: Slope version usually fewer probes — quantify.

revisionCard: Real BS: 100 fixed iterations > eps loops; announce precision math
Ternary = unimodal-only; strictness mandatory; slope-bisect often cleaner
Value-space doctrine: guess v → structural count(v) → bisect; never materialize universe
Staircase counter kills a row-or-column chunk per step
Exponential search brackets unbounded domains before bisection
Complexity formula: counterCost × log(range) — state it every time
Plateau safety: non-decreasing counts OK via first-true semantics
